labelling: Held-out set: labelled blind from eye-region contact sheets AFTER the detector's parameters were frozen on the female video. 'blinks' = frame of deepest closure. 'partial' lists blinks whose deepest sampled frame shows visibly open lids; 'completeness_unclear' could not be judged; all others were judged fully closed at that frame. 'ambiguous' covers deliberate eye closures >1 s and brief downward gaze; 'excluded' covers head turns/profile views and a long look-down.
